description: Firmware-grounded apps-grid geometry from DialogFullScreenPortal.svg and UI-APPS-GRID. The runtime mask transform resolves the cell insets, but a corrected stock capture is still required for pixel/layout parity.
reachability: DialogNavigator navigation code 0x80 constructs FullScreenPortalDialog. Senders: doNavigateFullScreenMarket at 0xd1aa2c (market return 0x29a) and OperationFinder::handleOperation case 0x79 at 0xd3e6a0. See apps-grid-reachability.txt.
runtime_insets: resolved: RectHandler applies HorizontalMaskScaleTransform to named rects, so rowPos maps onto the cell surface and +0x1fc/+0x200 reduce to horizontal mask widths. For this portal those masks are zero. See vgrid-inset-resolution.txt and vgrid-inset-test.txt.
